# Game Design Document: <Game Name>

> One-paragraph pitch. Genre, hook, the fantasy the player lives out, why it's worth playing.

## Pillars
Three to five non-negotiable design constraints every decision is checked against.
1.
2.

## Core Loop
The 10-30 second moment-to-moment loop. What the player does, what they get back, why they do it again.

## Mechanics
Per mechanic: what it is, the input, the feedback, how it interacts with the others. Keep numbers in the entity registry (`design/registry/entities.yaml`), not here.

## Progression
How the game opens up over a session and across sessions. Unlocks, difficulty ramp, mastery curve.

## Systems
The systems to build (player, combat, inventory, save, UI, audio, ...) and how they connect. Reference the shared component skills.

## Content
What exists in the shipped game: levels/biomes, enemies, items, bosses, story beats. Counts go here; balance values go in the registry.

## Win / Lose / Fail States
How a run ends. What success and failure look like.

## Scope
What is in v1 and what is explicitly cut. Be honest about the achievable slice.

## Open Questions
Unresolved decisions. Resolve before the relevant system is built.
